title: Jemm Son of Saturn #2 DC 1984 Gene Colan Klaus Janson Greg Potter Koolar
conditionDescription: Cover wear: paper scuffing and small surface tears along the lower left edge, light creasing, toned back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Jemm, Son of Saturn #2 (October 1984), DC Comics - 12-part maxi-series. Jemm vs. the Koolar - to the loser: death! Greg Potter, Gene Colan and Klaus Janson. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: Bump 'n' Jump (Intellivision / Atari 2600) video game ad.

Condition: cover wear with paper scuffing and small surface tears along the lower left edge, light creasing and a toned back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
